# R382 — production fixed-history capture seam for phase-cache serve

Date: 2026-10-13 (JST). Read-only source audit. W=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013, supplied clean HEAD `499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f`; adapter WT=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013, supplied HEAD `88ebaae...`. No Git command, edit to product source, test/build/import, process/service/GPU/model/profiler work, or cleanup. Read only source and closed research/implementation handoffs. No active Main logs/config or model/tensor/private environment files were read. This report is a source design finding, not implementation or production qualification.

## Finding

The smallest production seam is the **serial serving decode loop** in `src/program/generate.cpp`, around lines 10114–10267, especially `ver.run(T, window.data(), p, ..., outv.data(), err)` at 10189, contiguous accepted-prefix computation immediately after it (10193 onward), and `ver.commit(a + 1, err)` around 10222. Add a default-off fixed-history request mode at this loop and in the surrounding `GEN` request parser. It can use the already constructed phase-cache `ver` and normal request/session state advancement. It should capture each accepted row's raw logits after `run` and before the window buffers are reused, replace `outv[0..T)` with prevalidated continuation IDs, compute the same contiguous `a`, and let the existing commit/consumed/position progression advance state. The forced IDs therefore become the actual committed history. Do not perform another forward, replay/re-prefill the prompt, or implement a separate state path.

`Verifier::run` stages absolute row positions, computes PLE inputs, executes the captured verifier graph, and returns only after its normal queue completion. For this phase-cache mode, admission already requires `STRATA_VERIFY_SEGMENTED=1`; `Verifier::run` then waits for each segment's compute completion before inspecting handoff values and synchronizes final compute/copy work. The raw-head API is `Verifier::read_logits(rows, host, err)` (`src/core/verify.cpp:1779`), which copies `rows * n_vocab * sizeof(float)` from the last stage's head buffer; it is called after `run` and before the next window. Capture only the emitted/accepted prefix rows, not speculative rows after `a`. With one forced output per window (T=1), every successful iteration contributes exactly one row and every supplied continuation ID is consumed once. If retaining wider windows, use the same prefix equality logic as native `--spec-follow` and retain only rows `0..a`; reject unsupported window/pipeline modes until that path is separately proven.

## Position, request, and score contract

For prompt length P and fixed continuation length N, the first serial serving decode row consumes the prompt's final token at absolute position `P-1`; row i predicts continuation ID i at position `P-1+i`. Require `P >= 1`, exactly N validated in-vocabulary IDs, `P + N - 1 <= max_context`, successful normal completion, exact N captured rows, and no EOS/stop/cancel/truncation override. A diagnostic `score_all` option must override EOS stopping for this scoring request only, with that override recorded in the sidecar; otherwise EOS can shorten the target history. Preserve ordinary request masks/sampler configuration when the option is off. For fixed-history scoring, copy raw verifier logits before any output replacement and never apply sampler, penalties, grammar/masks, or temperature to the captured row; those are generation policy, not the target distribution. The captured raw float32 row is 248,320 floats (993,280 bytes) for vocab 248,320; N rows cost `993,280 * N` bytes plus the 8-byte `{vocab, rows}` header. Enforce the adapter's bounded capture budget before starting the request and write incrementally to the owned capture file.

The prompt needs the ordinary production prompt path exactly once; the initial request must have no matching/reused conversation/checkpoint state for a fresh-history proof. Existing phase-cache admission already imposes serve-only, one GPU, no MTP, no batch, no pipeline, no prompt/conversation reuse, native pack, cache 128 per layer, int8 KV, context 262144, chunk 8192 and no prefill borrowing. Phase-cache also enforces fresh GEN, pin=0, PCIe=0, empty actual reuse state and bounded requests. Do not weaken these constraints for capture. Preserve `STRATA_VERIFY_RESIDENT_GRAPH=0`, `STRATA_VERIFY_DEVICE_PLAN=0`, segmented=1, and the existing prefill route/env pins. Capture must be a separate quality run, never timed as quiet bench throughput.

## Existing implementation shape and adapter gap

The `GEN` parser in `src/program/generate.cpp:8399+` currently accepts `max_new`, sampling/logprob options, then prompt IDs. A minimal request extension can carry a fixed-follow token file/inline bounded list plus explicit capture destination and score-all behavior, validating the complete list and byte budget before prompt work. The serial path obtains decode windows at 10114+, calls `ver.run` at 10189, checks `drive.d.failed`, computes `a` at 10193, commits at 10222, then appends consumed window inputs and emits `outv[0..a]` around 10230+. The exact integration must ensure capture rows and forced continuation metadata agree with this order. Capturing before validation of `drive.d.failed` is wrong; replacing outputs before raw-logit copy is needlessly ambiguous. Write/flush/close errors must fail the request and be bound to the close receipt.

Current adapter `tools/fixed_history_capture_receipt.py` (WF) names provider `standalone-native-segmented-spec-follow-dump-logits`, requires argv `generate`, `--native`, `--pack`, `--tokens-file`, `--spec-follow`, `--dump-logits`, and fixed standalone options. It hard-codes the segmented init diagnostic from the verifier and requires a reviewed source owner hash, complete actual-owner command receipt, command/environment and artifact pre/post identities, model identity manifest, boot/fault/health interval and explicit close receipt. `REVIEWED_PRODUCERS` is empty; valid synthetic proofs cannot set `production_capture_qualified=true`. A serve capture cannot be made to pass honestly by relabeling its provider or fabricating standalone argv/evidence. Adapter work must explicitly extend the schema/provider and audited producer registry for the real serving controller, while preserving exact command, environment, identity, lifecycle, full-row geometry/finite scan, retention-consumer and retire-after checks. No fake producer registration or qualification claim is warranted by this source audit.

The adapter checks a capture row count and fixed-history positions/targets but does not itself prove causal session advancement. The serving producer must bind the source/model/runtime identities plus prompt/follow hashes, prompt count P, actual decode count N, positions `[P-1, P+N-2]`, target IDs, route settings, successful commits and final state/output evidence. The target quality comparison for the future 12K head-alias candidate must use the same fixed history and compare full-distribution metrics (including target NLL/KL and relevant state evidence); generated-text equality alone is not an acceptance criterion. This adds no performance or quality result.

## Guards and unresolved qualification

Keep direct submission off, pipeline=0, batch=0, MTP off, segmented=1, resident graph=0, device plan=0, no concurrent host-USM polling, no session reuse, no disconnected backend helper, and the current phase-cache source/runtime/provider pins. Require checked phase-cache owner readability and capacity, verifier completion, pool success, finite logits for every captured row, exact row bytes and positions, closed output files, zero owned-process survivors, clean fault/health interval, and no disconnect/re-prefill. If an error/nonfinite occurs after a capture prefix was written, classify the capture as failed/incomplete and do not score it as N rows.

Open issue: current server `GEN` returns sampled/generated output but has no arbitrary teacher-forcing request field or full-row artifact protocol. `logprobs=K` only emits selected scalar/top-K values and uses generated output IDs. The standalone comparator/adapter work is not serve qualification. The actual production producer/controller, sidecar writer, fixed-history serve mode, close/lifecycle attestation, adapter schema extension and reviewed provider registration remain unimplemented and unqualified. This report proposes source-only integration boundaries; it does not request or authorize capture execution during the current official bench phase.

## Evidence reviewed

- W source: `src/program/generate.cpp` phase-cache admission at 4112–4129; phase verifier setup/readable guard around 5965–5985; GEN parser/admission at 8399–8510; serial serve loop at 10114–10267; phase fresh-GEN and empty-reuse closure at 10335+.
- W verifier: `include/strata/core/verify.hpp` API contract; `src/core/verify.cpp` `Verifier::run` at 1460+, `read_logits` at 1779, and `commit` at 2407+. `run` records T and `pos0`, stages `pos0+t`, and waits for compute/copy completion in segmented mode before returning.
- WF adapter source: `tools/fixed_history_capture_receipt.py`; producer set is empty and its accepted command/provider contract is standalone-only.
- Closed reports retained as prior detail: `research-production-fixed-history-quality-hook-round319-v1.txt` (standalone fixed-history mechanics); `research-fixed-history-standalone-vs-serve-safety-round323-v1.txt` (serial segmented synchronization and serve seam); `implementation-fixed-history-production-receipt-adapter-v1.txt` (adapter authenticity/qualification limits); `research-head-alias-12288-admission-round381-v1.txt` (candidate admission remains separate).

No implementation, runtime test, capture, adapter qualification, model comparison, timing result, or adoption decision was produced.
